slots = {'P0':(15,19),'P1':(22,26),'P2':(29,33),'P3':(36,40),'P4':(43,47)}
targets = {
 'P0':'####.\n#..##\n#...#\n##..#\n.####',
 'P1':'#####\n#..#.\n#..#.\n####.\n#....',
 'P2':'#####\n#...#\n#.###\n#.#.#\n#####',
 'P3':'####.\n#..#.\n#..##\n#..#.\n####.',
 'P4':'..###\n..#.#\n#####\n#.#..\n###..',

    L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    c0,c1=slots[slot]

def solve_slot(slot):

        if cur_shape(slot)==targets[slot]:
            return True
        action(['UP'])
    return cur_shape(slot)==targets[slot]
# currently at P3
